Messages.Author: Barny Baker
Messages.Body:
I'm fairly sure this has been dealt with recently but may have
imagined it whilst drunk, anyway can't find the answer.

Malleable Visage, can it be played by a tapped vampire? e.g. Lambach
bleeds and gets let through, taps, fred the weak bleeds, blocked,
Lambach plays Malleable Visage and beats seven shades out of
unsuspecting blocker.

Or not?

Where's the bar in here?

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>I'm fairly sure this has been dealt with recently but may have
>imagined it whilst drunk, anyway can't find the answer.

You recollect correctly. =)

>Malleable Visage, can it be played by a tapped vampire? e.g. Lambach
>bleeds and gets let through, taps, fred the weak bleeds, blocked,
>Lambach plays Malleable Visage and beats seven shades out of
>unsuspecting blocker.

No. Errata made it require an untapped, ready vampire.

Malleable Visage
Requires a ready, untapped vampire. [RTR 20010710]

Halcyan 2
